title: Coproduct preservation for proper étale derived direct image
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category and let g : Z → Y be a proper morphism of schemes. Then the total right derived direct image Rg_* on the unbounded derived categories of A-valued sheaves on the small étale sites preserves coproducts of every set-indexed family.
